# Third-party model metadata

The DistilBERT tokenizer and vocabulary accompanying the exported model configurations originate from distilbert/distilbert-base-uncased, revision 12040accade4e8a0f71eabdb258fecc2e7e948be. Its Apache 2.0 license is retained in DistilBERT-LICENSE.txt.

TrOCR and DistilBERT pretrained model weights are downloaded separately from their official pinned Hugging Face revisions by scripts/download_models.ps1. Original ASAP-SAS and handwritten dataset archives are not redistributed in this repository; follow their original terms and citation requirements.
